{{Top|leg}}
A '''mass sensor'''<ref name="Kira">[[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']]</ref> or a '''mass shadow sensor'''<ref name="RPG2RE">''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> was a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]]. They were used aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to detect mass while a vessel was traveling through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. If a dangerous [[Mass shadow/Legends|mass shadow]] was detected in the ship's flight path, then it would trigger the [[hyperdrive inhibitor]], forcing the ship into [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]].<ref name="Kira" />
